'While this is defending, if you've been booed this turn, this gets +1{d}.' - Reviled Block.

SHAPE: copied from .drafts/darling_of_the_crowd_yellow.json, the identical printed text with 'cheered' in place of 'booed' (Revered Block), which itself follows the shipped defence statics (pen/basalt_boots.json et al.).

NAMING THE TRIGGER MATTERS: interpreter.dispatch_event defaults WHILE_STATIC to RECALC_ATTACK_POWER (interpreter.py:186-201); on that event combat.defense_recalc_card is None and MODIFY_DEFENSE falls back to its own source card (effect_types.py:2695-2699), quietly changing the {d} of a card that is not defending anything. RECALC_DEFENSE is dispatched once per declared defender by engine._recalculate_total_defense, which resets each defender to its base {d} first (engine.py:2046-2056) and re-applies statics - so the bonus cannot stack across recalculations, and it survives into total_defense because MODIFY_DEFENSE moves the DEFENDING CARD's own {d} (effect_types.py:2678-2714), which is what the pre-damage sum reads.

IS_DEFENDING_CARD (condition_types.py:564-604, self variant: combat.defense_recalc_card is this card) scopes the effect to THIS defender; without it the once-per-defender dispatch would let this static add +1{d} to every other defending card in turn - the documented .draft-review/beckon_applause defect. The dispatch reaches the defender itself plus both heroes and all permanents/equipment zones of both players, so this block hears its own recalculation whether it defends from hand or arena.

RELEASE NOTE ('always checking'; a boo arriving later during the attack still counts): IS_BOOED (condition_types.py:1701-1706, reads no params) tests the shared boo state for the whole turn via has_been_booed and is re-evaluated at every defense recalculation, so a boo after this was declared as a defending card is picked up by the next recalc pass. No extra machinery.

'Reviled' in the type line is a subtype/mechanic label with no clause of its own in the printed text; printed_keywords is empty, so nothing is authored for it.
